Citymaker.Scrapyard.Name: Scrapyard
Citymaker.Recipe.Scrapyard.Description: A fenced yard of scrap: haul loop, material bays, heaps, wrecks, containers or tyres, oily ground and a weighbridge at the gate.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.style.Tooltip: What the yard deals in. Each type has its own layout, not just different props.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.fill.Tooltip: How full the yard is: from a few tidy heaps to every corner crammed.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.aisle.Tooltip: Width of the haul loop and the aisles between rows and blocks.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.heapHeight.Tooltip: Raises real terrain under the big heaps so they read as mountains of scrap. 0 = flat. Permanent.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.machines.Tooltip: Material handlers, loaders, forklifts or reach stackers parked by the heaps and rows.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.strays.Tooltip: Single tyres, drums and bits of scrap lying about near the fence.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.visitorPaths.Tooltip: Walkable aisles from the gate, for pick-your-own-part yards.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.overgrowth.Tooltip: Car graveyard: share of the yard left alone long enough for trees and bushes to grow through the wrecks.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.fence.Tooltip: A sound fence, none, or a broken one with missing panels.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.screenTrees.Tooltip: A belt of trees just inside the fence that hides the yard from the street.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.weeds.Tooltip: Scrubby bushes along the fence and in the corners.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.office.Tooltip: A site cabin beside the way in.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.weighbridge.Tooltip: A concrete weighbridge slab across the road just inside the gate.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.paint.Tooltip: Paints the terrain texture under heaps and machines (oil-soaked ground). Permanent.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.paintLayer.Tooltip: Which of the map's terrain textures (1–4) to paint with.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.level.Tooltip: Levels the yard to one pad, blended back to the ground at the outline. Permanent.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.grime.Tooltip: Oil, dirt, puddle and crack decals per 100 m², gathered round heaps, machines and roads.
Citymaker.Scrapyard.Issue.NoCore: The yard is too small for a central scrap heap; only the edge bays were filled.
Citymaker.AddOn.JunkPiles.Name: Junk piles
Citymaker.AddOn.JunkPiles.mix.Tooltip: What the piles are made of.
Citymaker.AddOn.JunkPiles.grime.Tooltip: Oil and dirt decals round the foot of each pile.
Citymaker.AddOn.JunkPiles.strays.Tooltip: A few items that rolled off each pile.
